_comment: SHORT Fork-A-vs-B diagnostic (~30 min, 3v3, NOT 16 bots). Reads the read-only 'hard-room path shape' log (commit 7997eebf) to decide whether Theta* hands room-36 a straight over-mound CHORD (Fork B, len/chord ~1.0 -> fix the straightening) or a WINDING route (Fork A, len/chord >1.3 -> fix the hand-out). 3v3 because captures/threading are achievable there (the 7caf874f finale proved it) and room-36 gets worked without 16-bot chaos. gridall+outroute on so bots route through room 36 and it promotes to hard (firing the diag). One continuous 30-min isengard round (TimeLimit=60 so it never auto-advances). Grep the log for 'hard-room path shape: room 36' and take the len/chord distribution.
